name: PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk provides banking services for retail, small and medium enterprises (SMEs), and corporate customers in Indonesia. It operates through Retail and Wholesale segments. The company offers savings and current accounts; online and time deposits; saving plans; business savings; and debit and credit cards. It also provides personal and mortgage loans, as well as automotive financing; investment products, including bonds, mutual funds, exchange traded fund mutual fund, structured products, foreign exchange, and market insights; and personal, investment related, endowment, health, and general insurance products.
